messages.subject: Can't Sign Up On shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi all.

I've developed a Shiny app and am looking to host it, preferably on a private Shiny server at my institution.  I configured the free private Shiny server option which runs on a linux server, but it doesn't work properly so I'm in the process of troubleshooting it.  I'd like to troubleshoot it by running the app on shinyapps.io to see if the app runs.

I have a problem though.  I can't sign up to shinyapps.io.  When I go to https://www.shinyapps.io/ and click on the big Sign Up button, a new page loads, but it looks like this (see right side of screen):


I've tried this with firefox and rekonq on a linux system.  The sign up works for my phone, I just thought I'd bring it to the attention of whoever might be interested.

Cheers

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Can't Sign Up On shinyapps.io
parts:
Jeff,

Sorry for the issue you are running into.

We have been having a hard time reproducing the issue, and would help knowing your environment.
What is the version of Firefox on your Linux system? And what Linux distribution/version are you using?

Also, the browser caches could be problematic. Would you mind clearing your browser cache and retrying the URL?


Thanks,
Fereshteh

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Can't Sign Up On shinyapps.io
parts: I was running the Ubuntu Firefox Modifications 2.7 add-on.  Like a terrible scientist, I disabled it without first checking that the site still wasn't working for me, I then restarted firefox, and the sign up button now works!  I tried re-enabling the add-on and the sign up button still works, so I'm not confident that it was the add-on, but hey, at least it works now!
